Strategy:  The winning strategy for Nim is based on the concept of nim-sum. The nim-sum is calculated by XOR-ing the number of items in each pile. This can be achieved by making moves that maintain the nim-sum at zero or force your opponent into a losing position. By following this strategy, you can guarantee a win in Nim.

This number is determined by the binary XOR operation of the number of items in each pile at the start of the game. By following this strategy, you can force your opponent into a losing position where they have no winning moves left.

Game:  The game is Nim, a mathematical strategy game where players take turns removing items from a pile with the objective of leaving the last item for their opponent.
Strategy:  The winning strategy for Nim is based on the concept of nim-sum. Calculate the nim-sum of the number of items in each pile in binary form (XOR operation). If the nim-sum is zero at the start of your turn, you are in a losing position. Otherwise, make a move that changes the nim-sum to zero. This can be achieved by removing items from piles to balance the nim-sum. By following this strategy, you can force your opponent into a losing position and secure a win.

The winning strategy for Nim is based on the concept of nim-sum. The nim-sum of a game position is the bitwise XOR of the sizes of all the piles. A winning strategy involves ensuring that you always leave your opponent with a position that has a nim-sum of zero. This can be achieved by making moves that maintain the nim-sum at zero or force your opponent into a losing position. By following this strategy, you can guarantee a win in the game of Nim.
